Author: wallawallaslytherin
Name: Hovercast
Description: Automatic friendly casting through native unit frames, with no spell lists or macros. Includes strict invalid-recipient protection, self-cast and bypass modifiers, useful cast history, checked recovery, and optional ground placement at hovered allies. Keeps your selected target and native action queue.
Punchline: Automatic friendly mouseover casting with no spell lists.
Changelog: Hovercast uses /hovercast to open settings. Updated the plugin name, UI, help and documentation; /hovercast is the only registered command. Existing settings and the normal update path are preserved. Casting behavior is unchanged.

Author: wallawallaslytherin
Name: Gearset Organizer
Description: Preview and organize existing gearsets by role and job, with guarded sorting and undo. Works independently without companion plugins.
Changelog: Initial release: preview saved gearsets by role and job, sort with verified reference preservation, and undo the latest unchanged sort. Open with /gearsets. No companion plugin is required.
